questions.q: What does the Validate action check on a non-PO invoice?
options: Only whether the supplier bank account is active
Only the invoice date
Nothing — Validate is purely cosmetic
Required fields, whether distributions sum to the header amount, and tax calculation
questions.explain: Validate checks required-field completeness, distribution-to-header balance, and tax calculation (plus matching tolerance for PO-matched invoices).

questions.q: What was the actual root cause of INV-88341 failing to validate?
options: The supplier was on credit hold
A $30 freight line was added after distributions were generated, leaving the distribution total short of the header amount
The purchase order was closed
The invoice date was in a closed period
questions.explain: The distribution total ($18,420.00) was $30 short of the header amount ($18,450.00) because a late freight line never got a corresponding distribution.

questions.q: What should a consultant do first when a clerk says 'I click Validate and nothing happens'?
options: Immediately delete the invoice and re-enter it
Assume it's a system outage and escalate to Oracle support
Open the invoice themselves and click Validate to see the actual message Oracle returns
Change the supplier's payment terms
questions.explain: The consultant should reproduce the issue directly and read the exact validation message rather than relying on a paraphrase.

questions.q: What was the specific fix applied to resolve the ticket?
options: Added a $30.00 distribution to the freight expense account so the distribution total matched the header amount
Adjusted the matching tolerance template
Changed the invoice header amount to match the distributions
Released a hold manually
questions.explain: The fix added the missing $30.00 distribution rather than changing the header total or touching any tolerance setting.

questions.q: Why does the resolution note explicitly state 'No setup change was required'?
options: It has no particular purpose
Because Oracle requires that exact phrase on every ticket
Because setup changes are never allowed in production support
So a future reader doesn't assume a tolerance or validation rule was altered for all suppliers
questions.explain: Stating that no setup changed clarifies the fix was isolated to this one invoice's data, not a rule affecting other transactions.
